#==[ Command ]==
# /etc/krb5.conf
[libdefaults]
    default_realm = EXAMPLE.TEST
    dns_lookup_realm = false

[domain_realm]
    .example.test = EXAMPLE.TEST
    example.test = EXAMPLE.TEST

#==[ Command ]==
# /etc/hosts
127.0.0.1       localhost
::1             localhost
192.0.2.10      testhost01.example.test testhost01
#==[ Command ]==
